name: Sirok (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of yellow over light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Sirok: a blue shield with a castle on a rock, the year 1388, waves and a red and white embroidered base, bordered in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
